faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TN State Planning Commission Sector Expert (IT & Data Analyst) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the TN State Planning Commission Sector Expert (IT & Data Analyst) recruitment is 13 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sector Expert (IT & Data Analyst) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Cyber Security, Public Policy, Business Analytics, MBA, or a Post Graduate Diploma in Management in the specified sector, along with considerable field experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Sector Expert (IT & Data Analyst) position is below 50 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sector Expert (IT & Data Analyst) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month, which includes all allowances.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Sector Expert (IT & Data Analyst) position in the Tamil Nadu State Planning Commission.
